Name: Handsome Magnus The Wizard - Portrait and Sprites
Author: witchywitch99
Description:
This is a portrait mod that I created. It might not be the most sleek but it works and I'm happy with it. I created the portraits myself to mimic vanilla Stardew, there's multiple colours for the seasons but you can also just use one colour. 

The sprites included are slightly jazzed up to match, I used the vanilla sprite and Who_M's High Res Wizard Portrait as a reference for creating a more fashionable Magnus. 

[b]These are just images[/b], not an actual mod. I replaced the Magnus files in Seasonal Cute Characters SVE and changed the file names to match the ones already there. Then I just deleted the old ones so mine were the only ones left. I hope that makes sense. (He doesn't have a flower dance outfit file yet, so just use the spring file twice)

This is my first mod and mainly just a personal project, but I thought it would be fun to share if anyone else wanted a vanilla wizard portrait!
